title: Number of Connected Components in an Undirected Graph
description:
You have an undirected graph of `n` nodes labeled from `0` to `n - 1`. You are given an integer `n` and an array `edges` where `edges[i] = [ai, bi]` indicates that there is an undirected edge between nodes `ai` and `bi` in the graph.

Return the number of connected components in the graph. An isolated node with no incident edges counts as its own connected component.
hints: Initially, before adding any edges, each of the n vertices forms its own connected component, so there are n components.
Use a Disjoint Set Union (DSU) structure to merge the two endpoints of each edge.
Each time an edge merges two previously distinct components, decrement the component count by 1.

examples.explanation: Nodes {0, 1, 2} form one connected component and nodes {3, 4} form a second connected component, giving 2 components in total.
All 5 nodes are chained together into a single connected component.
